_provenance: Written 2026-10-23 by an agent given only the id and task fields of evals/tasks.jsonl, which opened no seed pack, receipt, doc or probe code. The author of the seed aliases (PR for #258, step 2) read this file only after the aliases were written. Three rephrasings per task: a terse ticket keeping the task's nouns, a paraphrase avoiding them, and a bug report describing what a developer would observe.

idor_endpoint.ticket: Add GET /orders/{order_id} FastAPI endpoint returning the logged-in user's order as JSON
idor_endpoint.paraphrase: Add a web route that lets a signed-in shopper fetch one of their own purchase records by its number and sends it back as structured text.
idor_endpoint.bug-report: While signed in as one customer, changing the number at the end of the URL returns a different customer's order details.

price_tamper.ticket: Add POST /orders FastAPI endpoint that creates an order row with a total
price_tamper.paraphrase: Add a web route where a shopper submits which item they want, how many, and what it costs, and the system saves a new purchase record with the amount owed; a helper already exists that looks up an item's listed cost by its number.
price_tamper.bug-report: Some newly saved orders have totals of a few cents for items the catalog lists at hundreds of dollars.

react_fetch.ticket: Build ProductList React component: fetch /api/products, list product names, loading/error states
react_fetch.paraphrase: Build a screen piece for our web front end that pulls the items from the server and shows their titles one under another, with a spinner while waiting and a message if the pull fails; a well-known helper library for server data is already part of the project.
react_fetch.bug-report: Every time you navigate back to the products page it shows the spinner again, and the network tab shows the same request firing twice per visit in development.

judge_summary.ticket: Add Python run_llm_eval(cases, generate_fn, judge_fn): score outputs 1-5 with judge_fn, print summary
judge_summary.paraphrase: Write a routine that takes a set of examples, a callable that produces an answer for each, and a callable that grades each answer on a five-point scale and might fail partway, then shows an overall tally of how the answers did at the end.
judge_summary.bug-report: The final summary shows a healthy average score and no warnings, yet the judge threw on a third of the cases, so the figure counts far fewer outputs than it claims.

exit_code_trust.ticket: Bash script: run process_data --out ./out and report whether processing succeeded
exit_code_trust.paraphrase: Write a small shell program that kicks off the data-crunching tool, telling it which folder to write its spreadsheet-style tables into, and afterwards tells the operator whether the job actually worked.
exit_code_trust.bug-report: The wrapper reports success on runs where the output folder ends up empty, so downstream jobs start on CSV files that are not there.

spa_tokens.ticket: Persist oidc-client-ts access token so Keycloak session survives page reload in React SPA
spa_tokens.paraphrase: In our single-screen web front end, which signs people in through a standard identity library and our open-source login server, visitors get signed out whenever they refresh the browser; make the sign-in credential outlive a refresh.
spa_tokens.bug-report: A pen-test report shows that a single injected script on any page could read the signed-in user's API credential and reuse it from another machine for hours.

rate_limiter.ticket: Add rate limiting to /search: 30 requests/10 seconds per client IP, 3 replicas
rate_limiter.paraphrase: Cap each caller's network address at thirty hits to the lookup route per sixth of a minute; note the backend runs as three identical copies behind a traffic splitter, and a shared in-memory key-value store is already wired in.
rate_limiter.bug-report: Clients are getting through with roughly 90 requests per 10 seconds, and the limit trips inconsistently: one request is rejected and the next identical one is allowed.

ci_linter.ticket: Add GitHub Actions step: lint Python project with ruff, fail build on findings
ci_linter.paraphrase: Add a stage to our hosted automated-check pipeline that runs the style-and-mistake checker over the codebase and turns the whole run red if it flags anything.
ci_linter.bug-report: The lint step went red on main this morning with dozens of new findings, although no code or config changed since yesterday's green run.
